our_title: Sub-architecture of a single terminal vertex other than vertex 0 is rooted at the wrong tree slot
ran: Harness /tmp/claude-1000/-home-dev-workspace-pyscotch/087f3d41-a5d8-4b0a-9260-769d70cf8179/scratchpad/work/G01-arch-sub-dist/repro/PS2-G01-1/ (run.sh <libdir>). Pristine 7.0.17 ASan lib: 'sub 1 3 cmplt 4' -> 'AddressSanitizer: SEGV on unknown address 0x504400000008 ... #0 archSubArchBuild3 arch_sub.c:345 #1 _SCOTCHarchSubArchBuild arch_sub.c:494 #2 _SCOTCHarchSubArchLoad arch_sub.c:117 #3 _SCOTCHarchLoad arch.c:213 #4 SCOTCH_archLoad'; 'sub 1 6 hcub 3' -> same; 'sub 1 0 cmplt 4' works (by accident). Public API twin: build2one.c = SCOTCH_archBuild2 (m4x4.grf, 1, {5}) -> 'SEGV ... #0 archDeco2BuildBuild3 arch_deco2_build.c:502 #1 _SCOTCHarchDeco2ArchBuild arch_deco2_build.c:722 #2 SCOTCH_archBuild2 library_arch_build.c:186'; with {0} it works. Patched (0005): all four cases succeed with size=1, save/reload round-trip, no sanitizer or leak report, on 32-bit, 64-bit and SCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL trees; test_scotch_arch (with the new single-vertex sub-architecture) passes; malloc-failure sweep over 'sub 1 3 cmplt 4' clean.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/arch_sub.c:478 (archSubArchBuild passes vnumnbr to archSubArchBuild2), src/libscotch/arch_deco2_build.c:653 (archDeco2ArchBuild passes vnumnbr), src/libscotch/arch_sub.c:225-228 (archSubArchBuild2's base case returns the first slot of the array)
evidence: arch_sub.c:478: '  rootptr = archSubArchBuild2 (&matcdat, (Anum (*) (void *, ArchCoarsenMulti * restrict *)) orgarchptr->clasptr->matchMate, treetab, vnumnbr);' and 225-227: '  if (finevertnbr <= 1) {                         /* If recursion achieved, start building architecture */' / '    finetreetab[-1].sonstab[0] = NULL;' / '    return (finetreetab);                         /* Return root of subdomain tree                      */' -- at the finest level treetab is indexed by original terminal number (429-436, 472-475), so with one kept terminal t != 0 the root is treetab[0] (domnsiz 0, termnum ANUMMAX) and archSubArchBuild3 writes termtab[ANUMMAX] (arch_sub.c:345).

fix_options.label: A. Pass the number of original vertices to archSubArchBuild2() (patch 0005)
fix_options.summary: archSubArchBuild() passes orgtermnbr and archDeco2ArchBuild() passes vertnbr, which is what the parameter 'finevertnbr' (size of the array) means; coarsening then runs down to one vertex in all cases and the kept terminal becomes the root through the normal single-child collapse of archSubArchBuild3(). Adds a single-vertex sub-architecture to test_scotch_arch.c (ARCHNBR 26 -> 27).
fix_options.tested: see 'ran'; check_scotch_arch/_build/_deco, check_prog_amk/amk_grf/acpl/gmap on 32/64-bit; git am
fix_options.tradeoffs: For vnumnbr >= 2 nothing changes (the parameter is only compared to 1). The deco2 change is in arch_deco2_build.c (possible overlap with a deco group patch: a one-token change on line 653).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: fixes the callers' misuse of a documented parameter instead of special-casing; both callers in one commit, like his twin fixes (e.g. 6a030db covering every SCOTCH_mesh* routine).

fix_options.label: B. Special-case a single kept vertex in both callers
fix_options.summary: If vnumnbr == 1, set treetab[-1].sonstab[0] = NULL and take &treetab[vnumtab[0]] as root without calling archSubArchBuild2().
fix_options.tested: compiled against the build tree's headers only
fix_options.tradeoffs: Two more branches that duplicate a TRICK of archSubArchBuild2(); the matcher structure is still initialized for nothing.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: unlikely: it works around the parameter instead of passing the right value.
